conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Officer Daniel Cooper from the IRS Criminal Investigations Department, badge number 60721. Who am I speaking with?
Hi, um, my name is Jamie Parker. I got a call from this number about my taxes, I think?
Thank you, Jamie. For verification, can you confirm your date of birth and the last four digits of your Social Security Number? This is regarding an urgent tax matter.
Uh, yeah, my birthday is July 10, 1999, and the last four are 5521. What's this about?
Jamie, our records show you are under investigation for potential tax evasion relating to your 2022 and 2023 filings. Did you file your taxes personally or use a third-party service?
I used TurboTax last year, but I thought everything was fine. Is there a problem?

Unfortunately, yes. There are discrepancies and indications of unreported income. As a result, a case has been opened against you, case ID TX-872954. Are you aware of any outstanding balances with the IRS?
No, I paid what it said I owed. This is really scary. What's going to happen?

Jamie, under federal law, failure to address these discrepancies can result in immediate legal action, including asset seizure and a warrant for your arrest. You were notified by certified mail twice and did not respond.
Wait, what? Arrest? I never got any letters. Are you sure you have the right person?

We only move forward with confirmed information. At this stage, your name is linked directly to this offense. If you don't resolve this immediately, law enforcement officers will be dispatched to your address today.
Oh my god, please, I don't want to be arrested! I really didn't mean to do anything wrong.
There is still a chance to rectify this before your case is escalated. If you settle the outstanding balance of $3,900 today, I can put your file on administrative hold and stop the arrest.
How am I supposed to pay that? I don't have that much in my bank account.

We are authorized to accept various forms of payment to resolve urgent tax cases. You can either process a wire transfer or use government-approved payment methods such as Bitcoin or prepaid gift cards.
I've never used Bitcoin before. Can't I just pay with my debit card or something?

Due to the status of your file and to expedite the payment, direct bank cards are not accepted for this type of resolution. You may go to a local convenience store and purchase Target or Apple gift cards totaling $3,900. Do you understand?
Um, it's a lot of money, but I guess I can try. So, just get the cards and then what?
Once you have purchased the cards, stay on the line and read me the numbers on the back. This will generate a payment receipt for your IRS file and halt further legal action.
Okay. I need to go to the store. Can I call you back when I have them?
No, Jamie. For security reasons, you must remain on the call during the entire process, or your file will be flagged as non-compliant. Are you ready to leave now?
Yeah, I guess so. I'll get my coat and head out.
Good. Please confirm when you arrive at the store. Remember, do not discuss this with anyone, as it is a confidential IRS investigation.
Alright, I won't say anything. I'm walking to the store now.
Excellent. Once you have the cards, read me each code carefully. If you fail to provide the correct information, the administrative hold cannot be applied, and your warrant will be activated.
I'm really scared. This won't go on my record, right?
If you cooperate fully, your record will remain clean, and you will not be detained. Now, please proceed with the purchase and let me know when you are ready.
